```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggstatsplot)

```

```{r}
#Przewalutowanie
Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  mutate(
    PricePLN = ifelse(
      Currency == "PLN",
      Price,
      round(Price * 4.23)
    )
  )
Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  relocate(PricePLN, .after = Price)
```

```{r}
df_brand <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  count(Vehicle_brand, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(perc = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_brand, aes(x = reorder(Vehicle_brand, n), y = n, fill = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(perc * 100, 1), "%")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6ECFF6", high = "#005B96") +
  labs(
    title = "TOP 20 najpopularniejszych marek samochodów",
    subtitle = "Z procentowym udziałem w całej bazie ogłoszeń",
    x = "Marka pojazdu",
    y = "Liczba modeli",
    fill = "Liczba"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(df_brand$n) * 1.15)
```

```{r}
df_bins <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  mutate(
    Price_trimmed = ifelse(PricePLN > 200000, 200001, PricePLN),
    Price_bin = cut(
      Price_trimmed,
      breaks = c(seq(0, 200000, by = 20000), Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0–20k", "20–40k", "40–60k", "60–80k", "80–100k",
        "100–120k", "120–140k", "140–160k", "160–180k", "180–200k", ">200k"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Price_bin) %>%
  summarise(N = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = N / sum(N),
    percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
  )
```

```{r}
# Wykres
ggplot(df_bins, aes(x = Price_bin, y = N, fill = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent_label), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6baed6", high = "#08306b", name = "Udział %", labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Liczba ogłoszeń ze względu na cenę (PLN)",
    x = "Przedział cenowy",
    y = "Liczba ogłoszeń"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
#Mediana
Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  filter(Vehicle_brand %in% c("Suzuki","Honda"))%>%
  ggbetweenstats(
    x=Vehicle_brand,
    y=PricePLN,
    xlab="Marka",
    ylab="Cena",
    bf.message = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = " ", scientific = FALSE)
  )
```

```{r}
  )
```

```{r}
df_condition <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  filter(Condition %in% c("New", "Used")) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = N / sum(N),
    percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_condition, aes(x = "", y = N, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent_label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "New"  = "#6baed6",
      "Used" = "#08306b"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "New"  = "Nowe",
      "Used" = "Używane"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Struktura ogłoszeń według stanu pojazdu",
    subtitle = "Podział na samochody nowe i używane",
    fill = "Stan pojazdu"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
df_mileage_bins <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%

  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = N / sum(N),
    percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
  )
```

```{r}
df_drive_clean <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  mutate(
    Drive_clean = case_when(
      grepl("^4x4", Drive, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "4x4",
      Drive %in% c("AWD", "All-wheel drive")   ~ "4x4",
      TRUE                                    ~ Drive
    ),
    Drive_clean = fct_recode(
      Drive_clean,
      "4x4" = "4x4",
      "Przednia oś" = "Front wheels",
      "Tylna oś" = "Rear wheels"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pie_plot <- function(data, var, title, legend_title = "") {
  
  df <- data %>%
    count({{ var }}) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = n / sum(n),
      percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
    )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = {{ var }})) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = percent_label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = blue_palette_dark,
      name = legend_title
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Przygotowanie danych
dane <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  select(Power_HP, PricePLN) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(
    between(
      PricePLN,
      quantile(PricePLN, 0.01),
      quantile(PricePLN, 0.85)
    ),
    between(
      Power_HP,
      quantile(Power_HP, 0.01),
      quantile(Power_HP, 0.99)
    )
  )


# Wykres: cena vs moc silnika (bez obserwacji skrajnych)
ggplot(dane, aes(x = Power_HP, y = PricePLN)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 45) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = c(
      "#c6dbef",  # < 100  (jasny, ale widoczny)
      "#9ecae1",  # 100–499
      "#6baed6",  # 500–999
      "#4292c6",  # 1000–1999
      "#2171b5",  # 2000–4999
      "#084594"   # ≥ 5000 (bardzo wysoka gęstość)
    ),
    breaks = c(1, 100, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000),
    labels = c(
      "< 100",
      "100–499",
      "500–999",
      "1000–1999",
      "2000–4999",
      "≥ 5000"
    ),
    name = "Liczba ogłoszeń"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Zależność ceny samochodu od mocy silnika",
    x = "Moc silnika (KM)",
    y = "Cena pojazdu (PLN)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )



```
